name: Pivot articulating mount

name: 15/16 in T-bar adapter for flat surface, outlet box, conduit, or all-thread
notes: Enables mounting of FAPs with a 15/16 in. T-bar mount to flat surfaces (wall, ceiling), an outlet box (single, double gang, and 4x4 junction box), hanging conduit (3/4 in. trade size), and hanging all-thread (3/8 in.). Listed only in the per-model matrix. Hanging conduit has no mount type. The 3/8 in. all-thread joins the AP's existing 15/16 in. T-bar mount.

name: Under-seat wedge or wall enclosure
notes: "Under-seat wedge / wall mount enclosure for stadiums and arenas".

name: NEMA 4X polycarbonate enclosure
notes: "12 x 10 x 6 inch NEMA 4X Polycarbonate Enclosure, indoor or outdoor use". FAP-441K is listed; FAP-443K is not.

name: Articulating wall or mast mount (5 pack)
notes: "Wall or Mast mounting solution for outdoor Access Points (Pack of 5)". Matrix columns: "Fully Articulated Wall Mount" and "Pole/Mast Mount".

name: Universal articulating pole and wall bracket (5 pack)
notes: Listed only in the per-model matrix. The matrix also lists "FAP-HD-222KL"; that name does not match FAP-222KL, so it is not added.

name: 23JK desktop stand (10 pack)
notes: "Optional desktop stand of FAP-23JK (pack of 10). Backward compatible to FAP-23JF model."
